memory.help.summary: Read and curate the scope's memory journal: facts and lessons
memory.help.detail:
deckent memory [--scope <id>] [--state candidate,verified,retired] [--json]
  Lists the scope's memory entries, most recently changed first (candidate and verified unless --state names others).
deckent memory search <words...> [--scope <id>] [--state ...] [--json]
  Finds entries that contain every word (case and accents ignored).
deckent memory inspect <entry-id> [--scope <id>] [--json]
  Shows one entry with its source, verification and every revision.
deckent memory propose --input <file> [--scope <id>]
  Proposes the fact or lesson in the JSON file as a candidate under your name.
deckent memory verify <entry-id> --note <text> [--scope <id>]
  Verifies a candidate after your own review.
deckent memory retire <entry-id> --reason <text> [--superseded-by <entry-id>] [--scope <id>]
  Retires an entry; it and its revisions stay readable.
Propose, verify and retire run only on your own terminal, each on one card; AI tools, pipes and --json are refused. An entry becomes verified only through a person's review or an independent evaluation record, never by the AI itself; nothing is ever deleted.
memory.help.action.inspect: show one entry with its history
memory.column.title: Title
memory.none: No memory entries in this scope for the chosen states.
memory.search.method.full-text: Searched with the full-text index for: {terms}.
memory.search.method.scan: Searched the newest {count} entries for: {terms} (this store has no full-text index).
memory.search.incomplete: Older entries were not searched; narrow the words or the states.
memory.held: Memory could not be read ({code}): nothing is answered from an incomplete memory. {next}
memory.held.next.MEMORY_UNAVAILABLE: Check that the service has started this installation once and that `deckent doctor` reports the ledger and integrity key as healthy.
memory.held.next.MEMORY_CORRUPT: A memory record failed its integrity check. Keep the installation as it is and restore or inspect it with `deckent backup verify`.
memory.notFound: No memory entry {id} in this scope.
memory.view.author: Proposed by {author} ({who}) from {origin}
memory.view.unverified: Not verified: an agent must not rely on it as verified knowledge.
mcp.tool.listMemory: List the scope's memory entries (read-only; held when the memory cannot be read, never an empty answer).
mcp.tool.searchMemory: Search the scope's memory entries by words (read-only; names the search method; held on a read failure).
mcp.tool.inspectMemory: Show one memory entry with its provenance, verification and revisions (read-only).
policy.mcp.note.memory: Lets the AI read the scope's memory journal. Reading never verifies or changes an entry.
error.MEMORY_UNAVAILABLE: The memory journal, its policy or its integrity key is unavailable.
error.MEMORY_CORRUPT: A memory record failed its integrity checks.
error.MEMORY_COMMAND_CONFLICT: This command id was already used for a different memory change.
error.MEMORY_REVISION_CONFLICT: The memory entry changed since it was read; read it again and retry with its current revision.
error.MEMORY_NOT_FOUND: No such memory entry in this scope.
error.MEMORY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The memory change may or may not have been saved; retry the same command id to learn its outcome.
error.MEMORY_ENTRY_INVALID: The memory entry is invalid or above its limits.
error.MEMORY_TRANSITION_INVALID: This memory entry cannot make that change in its current state.
error.MEMORY_VERIFIER_NOT_HUMAN: Only a person can do this: the AI cannot verify memory or retire verified memory.
error.MEMORY_SELF_VERIFICATION: The evaluation was made by the entry's own author; verification needs an independent evaluator.
error.MEMORY_EVALUATION_UNAVAILABLE: No evaluation record could be resolved for this verification; nothing was verified.
error.MEMORY_EVALUATION_NOT_PASSED: The evaluation record did not pass; nothing was verified.
error.MEMORY_EVALUATION_OTHER_CONTENT: The evaluation record judged other content; nothing was verified.
error.MEMORY_QUERY_INVALID: The search needs at least one word and must stay within its size limit.

memory.card.retire.title: Retire this memory entry?

memory.done.retired: Entry {id} is retired (revision {revision}); its history is kept.
